# gitversion

**Tag**: library

## 简介

Versioning when using git, solved. GitVersion looks at your git history and works out the semantic version of the commit being built.

## 官网

- 主页: https://github.com/GitTools/GitVersion
- 文档: https://www.rubydoc.info/gems/gitversion/5.1.3
- RubyGems: https://rubygems.org/gems/gitversion
